steps.text: Research stations and disease cubes by the board, cubes sorted by color; 1 research station in Atlanta
Outbreaks marker on 0; the 4 cure markers vial side up by the cure indicators
Infection rate marker on the leftmost 2
Shuffle the Infection cards: flip 3 and put 3 cubes on each city, 3 more with 2 cubes, 3 more with 1 cube; the 9 cards go to the Infection discard
A reference card and 1 random Role card each; matching pawns in Atlanta
Take the Epidemic cards out, shuffle the Player cards and deal {n} each
Choose 4, 5 or 6 Epidemic cards (Introductory, Standard, Heroic); split the Player cards into that many piles, shuffle 1 Epidemic into each and stack them, smaller piles at the bottom

details: Action: take an Event card from the player discard pile and keep it on his role card (1 at a time, not part of his hand)
When he plays that stored Event, it is removed from the game
Action: move any pawn to a city that has another pawn
Action: move another player's pawn as if it were his own (ask first)
Treat Disease removes all cubes of one color
Cured diseases: their cubes leave his city without an action, and none can be placed there
Action: build a research station in his city without a City card
Once per turn, as an action: move from a research station to any city by discarding any City card
No cubes are placed and no outbreaks happen in her city or the cities connected to it (setup cubes still go down)
Share Knowledge: may give any City card from her hand, not only the card of the city she is in
A player sharing with her on their turn may take any 1 of her City cards
Discover a Cure with 4 cards of one color instead of 5

steps.text: The player with the highest City population in hand goes first
